scope: fixed GF(256), four support x-coordinates, at most six Boolean selector variables; no external curve or target inputs
matrix_metric: Boolean Macaulay ideal-completion budget; F5 row criterion, not intrinsic regularity
quotient: finite image of elementary symmetric x-coordinates, addressed by lexicographic rank; reconstruct by polynomial division, preserving multiplicities
cost_unit: executed CPython opcode dispatches over setup, encoding, matrix-F5 solve/root extraction, reconstruction and point verification; one extra instrumented replay per input
cost_boundary: ordered decomposition call on the identical supplied support and target; arithmetic tables and curve/support generation are fixture inputs, not priced inside the call
cost_limitations: Python opcode proxy includes Python callees, not C-internal instruction counts; not calibrated machine operations or a native-runtime speedup
decision: invariant aggregate opcode cost <= 0.8 times ordered for each summand count and model on BOTH fresh seeds, with identical verified unordered signed-point decompositions and zero correctness failures
controls: report every cost and degree delta, including regressions; compare source-neighbor differences under every fixed representation without selecting winners

independent_audit.input_order: Boolean field equations first, then packed generators in their recorded order
independent_audit.validation: Buchberger is required on every selected case; F5B budget exhaustion is retained separately and blocks a claim of complete F5B validation
independent_audit.budget_checkpoint: main F5B line boundaries; an individual step can overshoot the nominal call cap

stop: retain any failed or timed-out case and block the success claim; fixed 1920 inputs, no adaptive parameter search
preflight_revision: Before production measurement: preserve v1; add deterministic F5B call cap after six-variable correctness preflights exceeded wall limits. No measured corpus results selected.
audit_instrumentation_fix: Run-001 retained as superseded: profile exceptions could arise during generator cleanup. Run-002 checks the same call budget at F5B main-loop line boundaries, with GC disabled only during audit counting. Thresholds, cases and solver algorithms are unchanged.
